full_prompt_en: A square surreal painting shows a solitary small figure standing in a dim field of thin dry grass. The figure is placed slightly left of center and seen in side view, facing right. A brown layered coat falls to the knees, with narrow legs and feet planted on almost black earth. The head is a strange fan-shaped form, its broad pale brown planes extending backward in pointed ridges and tapering toward a small hidden face. Long fine strands trail from the lower edge of the head. The hands hold a small pale object near the waist, but its exact purpose remains unclear. Behind the figure, grass becomes a faint horizontal band before dissolving into dark olive gray haze. The sky and ground have no crisp boundary. Light is weak and diffuse, catching the upper planes of the unusual head and a few folds of the coat while leaving the legs and field subdued. The image has a matte, finely grained painted surface, with soft smudged transitions rather than hard outlines. Its color range is narrow: brown, olive, charcoal and muted tan. The figure is modest in scale, surrounded by broad shadow and empty air. The composition feels quiet and unsettling, as though a peculiar traveler has paused in a place with no clear time or destination.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形超现实绘画呈现一个孤独小身影站在昏暗、布满细干草的田地里。形体略偏中央左侧，从侧面看向右。棕色分层外套垂至膝，窄腿和双脚踩在近黑土地上。头部是奇特扇形，宽阔的浅棕平面以尖脊向后展开，向前收至一张隐藏的小脸。几条细长线从头的下缘垂出。双手在腰旁握着一个浅色小物，但具体用途不清。身后草形成微弱水平带，然后消散在深橄榄灰雾里。天与地没有清脆边界。光微弱漫散，只照到奇异头形上方平面和外套少数折线，腿与田地保持低调。画面是哑光细颗粒绘画表面，柔和擦染过渡多于硬轮廓。色彩范围狭窄：棕、橄榄、炭色与柔和黄褐。身影尺度不大，被宽阔阴影和空空气包围。构图安静而不安，像古怪旅行者在没有明确时刻或终点的地方停住。
style_prompt_en: The surreal painting has a narrow, matte range of olive gray, brown, charcoal and muted tan. Soft atmospheric blending nearly erases the boundary between horizontal ground and background, while a small angular cluster remains more legible near the center. Pale ridges catch weak diffuse light; surrounding forms retreat into grainy shadow. Fine trailing lines and dry vertical marks give sparse texture against broad empty space. The restrained scale and low contrast create an eerie, suspended calm.
style_prompt_zh: 这种超现实绘画拥有狭窄的哑光橄榄灰、棕、炭色和低饱和黄褐色域。柔和空气融合几乎擦掉水平地面与背景的界线，中央附近一小组棱角形体保持较清楚。浅色凸脊接住微弱漫光，周围形状退入颗粒阴影。细长垂线与干燥竖笔在宽阔空域前提供稀疏纹理。克制尺度和低对比形成怪异、悬停的平静。
theme_en: A solitary figure with a fan-shaped head in a dark field
theme_zh: 暗色田野中头部呈扇形的孤独身影
name: Anton Semenov
